blockingFindings.summary: The native directory helper returns a context manager, not a bare file descriptor. Both positive and rejection paths must enter the context.
Suffix filtering omits the English and Chinese Markdown help files required by the source manifest.
The final status query can consume a separate timeout after stop, exceeding the shared 90-second envelope.
Transport launch and timeout exceptions occur outside failure receipt handling.

additionalLimits: Only the parent cgroup process list is inspected; recursive emptiness remains unverified.
Supplementary groups and host UNIX socket visibility are not verified.
Archive dependency closure is not independently established.

nextAction: Obtain one grouped approval for local corrections and targeted regression; preserve existing freeze and request; do not consume remote quota until review gates pass.
